sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao Portrait

Ricky Hsiao appears against a simple gray background, dressed in a vibrant yellow blazer layered over a mint green checked shirt and a pink sweater. He accessorizes with oval green sunglasses and a black floral lapel pin, while his dark hair falls in loose waves around his face. The image is taken from his Spotify artist profile, where he is noted to have 636.8K monthly listeners.

This promotional portrait highlights his contemporary style and confident presence, reflecting his identity as a modern musician.

蕭煌奇 20周年美西個唱宣傳照

Taiwanese singer-songwriter 蕭煌奇 appears in a stylish studio portrait, wearing dark sunglasses and a black shirt adorned with white abstract doodles. This image accompanies the announcement of his first solo concert on the U.S. West Coast, set for August 9 at Yaamava’ Resort Casino at San Manuel in Highland, California. The performance marks his 20th anniversary in the music industry and will feature special guest 萬芳.

sources.title: Vision-impaired award-winning singer bags judo gold at World Masters Games - Focus Taiwan
sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s Bold Portrait

Ricky Hsiao, the vision-impaired Taiwanese singer and judo gold medalist at the 2025 Summer World Masters Games, stands confidently against a white background. He sports a vibrant gradient shirt blending pink, yellow, and blue hues, paired with a pastel-patterned tie and sleek sunglasses.

This portrait captures Hsiao’s dynamic personality and recent athletic achievement. The image reflects both his bold fashion sense and his triumph in judo, as reported by Focus Taiwan and archived in the CNA English news archive.

sources.title: 萧煌奇8月19日狮城开唱 - vibes by 8world
sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao Promotional Portrait

Ricky Hsiao, the award-winning Taiwanese singer, poses against a plain gray backdrop wearing a burgundy jacket and dark sunglasses. He offers a thumbs-up with a warm smile, showcasing his approachable and upbeat personality.

Hsiao, known for hits like “你是我的眼” and “末班车,” will make his Singapore solo concert debut on August 19 at 8pm in the Sands Theatre at Marina Bay Sands. A four-time Golden Melody Award winner, he blends humor and heartfelt performance, promising fans both great music and his signature wit.

sources.title: 今天不開玩笑！蕭煌奇曬婚戒曝結婚喜訊 | 娛樂 | Newtalk新聞
sources.description:
蕭煌奇時尚宣傳照

金曲歌王蕭煌奇身著綠色西裝與黃色襯衫，配戴墨鏡，優雅地坐在棕色皮椅上，背景為暖色調。這張照片展現了他成熟穩重的個人風格，並可能與他近日在社群平台曬婚戒、宣布結婚喜訊的動態相關。

蕭煌奇在社群平台無預警分享與女友的婚戒，幽默表示「今天沒有要跟你開玩笑、我結婚了」。兩人透過朋友介紹交往一年，選在無工作行程的日子完婚。消息曝光後，網友紛紛湧入祝福，恭賀這位出道25年的歌王新婚快樂。

sources.title: ‎《说故事的歌》- 萧煌奇的专辑 - Apple Music
sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s “说故事的歌” Album Cover

Ricky Hsiao sits pensively at a wooden desk, dressed in a beige blazer and dark sunglasses. A vintage radio and a softly glowing lamp create a nostalgic atmosphere against a rich wood-paneled background. The album title “说故事的歌” and the artist’s name appear in elegant gold typography alongside the English name “RICKY HSIAO” and the label “SABA.”

Released in 2022 on Apple Music, “说故事的歌” features 10 tracks totaling 47 minutes. The cover’s warm lighting and retro elements reflect the storytelling theme of the album.

Young Ricky Hsiao with Medals

Dressed in a white T-shirt with blue sleeves and light shorts, he smiles broadly, capturing a moment of youthful triumph and innocence. The warm, slightly dim lighting and the cluttered background of a home interior add to the nostalgic feel of the photograph.
